headline: A new AI assistant called Tab has come out of stealth, and people run it by texting it.
score_reason: Pool 5, lowered 1: the launch was announced on Tuesday 6 Oct, before 7 Oct (stale).
importance_line: It adds one more assistant that acts for people, such as paying bills and booking travel, but the $300 million figure is the company's and no outside check of how it handles cards and accounts is reported.
summary: TechCrunch reports that Meet Tab, the startup behind a personal AI assistant called Tab, came out of stealth on Tuesday, 6 Oct 2026, at a reported $300 million valuation, though it declined to share exact funding details. Users text Tab on iMessage or WhatsApp to book travel, order groceries or buy gifts, and a co-founder says the assistant has its own phone number and wallet.
